scope: One untuned support-weighted combination on exposed v107 supervised development panels. Compare repaired v109, additive v111, hard fallback v112 and a fixed equal-mixture attribution control. No new source, model selection, outside-word input, Voynich scoring or independent qualification.

support_rule.counts: For a real word at position i, n_local=sum over training roles count(i:word), n_pool=sum count(W:word), n_other=n_pool-n_local. These are nonnegative feature-event counts, not independently sampled observations or proven reliability estimates. Three other offsets provide more count opportunities; that is explicit in this candidate, not normalized away after outcomes.
support_rule.weights: If n_pool>0, w_local=n_local/n_pool and w_shared=n_other/n_pool. Otherwise both0. All supported real-word slots have total weight1. Counts are pooled across roles; test frequencies, test gold and which role is favored cannot enter weights. No free alpha or tuned cutoff.
support_rule.likelihood: Weighted sum w_local*old_log_likelihood(i:word)+w_shared*old_log_likelihood(W:word), with exact v111 shared-model counts/vocabulary/denominators and v109 repaired unknown neutrality. The shared likelihood is pooled over ALL offsets, while its weight uses only n_other to avoid recounting local support in weight calculation. Likelihood channels still overlap statistically; no independence claim.
support_rule.boundaries_pairs: Boundary markers remain positional only, weight1 if recognized else0; never pooled. Original two exact pair features retain their original score contributions; no singleton suppression. A word absent in one role but globally present remains evidence with existing add-one smoothing.
support_rule.corners: n_local0/n_otherpositive reproduces shared fallback; n_other0/n_localpositive uses positional evidence only; totalzero remains neutral. Repeated surface words at different offsets retain separate occurrence budgets.

arms.baseline: Exact v109 six-event model and scorer.
arms.additive: Exact v111 ten-event shared model, all original and shared contributions.
arms.fallback: Exact v112 positional-first selection, six active slots under v111 shared-model parameterization.
arms.weighted: New support-weighted convex per-word combination, shared-model parameters fixed; original pairs unchanged.
arms.equal_mix: If local and shared real-word evidence both exist, weights.5/.5. If only one exists, use that channel at1. If neither, both0. Boundaries and pairs same as weighted. Diagnostic control isolates count-derived weights from normalization; not a competing winner selected after results.

parameters: Only two model forms fit per panel/control: unchanged v109 six-event counts and unchanged v111 ten-event counts. Baseline/additive/fallback actual predictions must reproduce saved results. Weighted combiner is the sole new scoring step; original likelihood terms, prior, smoothing and1e-12 tie/abstention policy stay fixed. Normalized score probabilities are not certified confidence.

evaluation.panels: Original four adequately supported primary panels, all eight retained. Identical808 binary-role test IDs, gold, whole-block split and training membership.
evaluation.measures: All-case balanced correct-credit(.5 abstention), strict balanced recall(abstentionsmisses), pooled/equal-panel decision coverage, balanced log loss and two-class Brier. Per-role counts, new support and every gain/loss retained. No headline based only on decided cases.
evaluation.goal: Report simultaneous observed recovery/coverage improvements and confidence-score change versus repaired baseline. Also report additive/fallback/equal-mixture differences; no post-result success tolerance. Improved expected recovery with worse confidence or harms must be explicit.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000pairedwhole-test-block bootstrap draws per panel/comparator:weightedminusbaseline/additive/fallback/equal_mix;64000paneldraws.95% intervals descriptive on exposed data, no training/model-selection uncertainty.
evaluation.controls: 199within-blockcontext-column shuffles plus199within-blocktraining-label shuffles per panel. Refit both model forms and recompute support weights from each control training set. Evaluate allfivearms on same data;3184fivearmtrials. Seeds1131000/1132000,bootstrap1133000..1136000. Save paired deltas and descriptiveBonf8 ranks; no qualification promotion.

fixtures: Local and other-position weights derive only from training counts, sum1 and stay nonnegative.
No overlapping local observations counted again in n_other.
Only-local,only-shared and no-evidence corners behave as specified.
Boundary markers never use shared evidence.
Role renaming cannot change support weights.
At fixed total support, increasing local support increases local weight.
Weighted term lies between its two component likelihood terms; no doubled vote.
Original baseline,additive and fallback outputs reproduce exactly.
limits: Relative event count is a concrete support heuristic, not a measured posterior reliability. The pooled likelihood includes local examples and component/pair features remain correlated. This tests one formula and does not qualify every interpolation or claim semantic role recovery. Existing source panels are exposed development material.
